dashboard.welcome: A quick walkthrough of the essentials. You can skip anytime.
dashboard.create: Create an auction in under a minute from here: name, description and end date.
dashboard.quota: Each auction shows its used lots, people and photos. The red badge marks finished ones.
dashboard.myAuctions: Auctions you created. The trash icon on the top right deletes them with confirmation.
dashboard.joined: Other people's auctions show up here when you accept an invitation or join with a link.
dashboard.bids: Track your active bids here and whether you're winning or outbid.

create.welcome: Only the name is required. The end date defaults to 30 days.
create.name: A clear name sells better: what is auctioned and for whom.
create.endDate: Optional. Left as is, it closes in 30 days. It can never exceed that cap.
create.itemEndMode: Choose whether your lots end with the auction, on a custom date, or never.
create.submit: Create the auction, then add items from its page.

item.welcome: This is an item at auction. Here's where to bid and follow along.
item.bid: Enter your amount above the minimum and confirm. Bids are binding: they can't be retracted.
item.history: All bids in order, highest highlighted. The yellow badge marks new accounts.
item.fulfillment: Once closed with a winner, payment and delivery are coordinated here, and both sides can rate each other.
item.discussions: Ask the owner or chat with other members. They lock once the item ends.

itemCreate.welcome: Let's complete your lot step by step. Only name and starting bid are required; the rest has sensible defaults.
itemCreate.basic: The name is required and the first thing bidders see. Description supports rich text (up to 500 characters).
itemCreate.currency: Item currency (e.g. CLP). All bidding on this lot happens in that currency.
itemCreate.pricing: The starting bid is the floor (can be 0). The minimum increment avoids $1-by-$1 raises.
itemCreate.maxBid: Anti-joke cap: bids above this amount are rejected automatically. Empty = no cap.
itemCreate.normalized: Only for multi-currency auctions: base-currency equivalents and constraints. Leave empty otherwise.
itemCreate.endDate: Optional. Defaults to the cap: never past the auction end date or 30 days.
itemCreate.anon: If enabled, bidders can't see each other (you as owner still see who bids).
itemCreate.discussions: Allow questions and comments on the item. On by default; turn off for silence.
itemCreate.antiSnipe: A bid in the final minutes extends the close automatically. Set window and extension in seconds.
itemCreate.admin: Let auction admins edit this item for you. Off by default.
itemCreate.submit: Creating takes you to step 2: upload photos and publish. Unpublished items stay invisible drafts.
